searchText: Blobs are RLP again, network form can be optimized a little: For example > blobs - list of blob where blob is a list of BLSFieldElement Which means it is an array of arrays of arrays Can we have blobs as just array of all blobs? - fewer bytes, - simpler to pass in engine_newPayloadV3; - the same is it will be in the future(in case we try SSZ again) Can be applied to proofs and commitments too Wdyt guys? OK if BLSFieldElement can have dynamic length it allows to save some length each blob is flat vector i think so blobs => array of bytes array however wouldn't prefer to flatten further At least like that 👍 but would want network transaction to change to: `[tx_payload, blobs, commitments, proofs]` (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7038) rather than current `[tx_payload, kzgs, blobs, kzg_proofs]` i.e. blobs first then commitment s and proofs rather than blobs in middle of commitments and proofs if this isn't clear may be we just PR a clarification to EIP? have been operating under assumption that blob is flat Yeah, can be a small addition to your pr or like that ok i can update a clarification into it Thanks! does this look good?```diff --- a/EIPS/eip-4844.md +++ b/EIPS/eip-4844.md @@ -275,7 +275,7 @@ rlp([tx_payload, blobs, commitments, proofs]) Each of these elements are defined as follows: - `tx_payload` - standard EIP-2718 blob transaction `TransactionPayload` -- `blobs` - list of `blob` where `blob` is a list of `BLSFieldElement` +- `blobs` - list of `blob` bytes where each `blob` is `BLSFieldElement`s flattened in `big endian` - `commitments` - list of `KZGCommitment` of the corresponding `blobs` - `proofs` - list of `KZGProof` of the corresponding `blobs` and `commitments` ``` or: ``` - `blobs` - list of `blob` bytes where each `blob` is `BLSFieldElement` list flattened in `big endian` ``` Sounds good updated could you review the PR: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7038 cc <@159152274659082240> <@898563924440543283> <@543900561460822016> <@552133098075193354> <@277500722655002624> ... I cannot review, but lgtm. Could you add more details (maybe reasoning) to the PR for the `reorders the network payload to...` point? https://twitter.com/Gajpower/status/1660622342098149382 <@792822129019584562> <@543900561460822016> should we be using "destination" instead of "to" for the RLP destination address field name, as in 1559? https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559 hmm there are mentions of `to` else where as well like: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2718, also `ELs` (atleast ethereumjs) use `to` field in the txs, however i am fine with updating to `destination ` with `to` 's translation to `destination` kept somewhere looks like the shift from "to" to "destination" appeared in 1559 ... access list transaction EIP still used "To" (https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2930). ok, will add this update in the cleanup PR as well 👍 maybe let <@543900561460822016> confirm as he may have more context. <gakonst> We call it `to` in ethers-rs which is strongly typed and haven’t seen any RPC server error when sending eth_sendTransaction w/ 1559+2718, so assuming this isn’t rolled out in clients as strictly `destination`?

excerpts.author: __flcl
excerpts.content:
Blobs are RLP again, network form can be optimized a little:
For example
> blobs - list of blob where blob is a list of BLSFieldElement
Which means it is an array of arrays of arrays

Can we have blobs as just array of all blobs?
- fewer bytes,
- simpler to pass in engine_newPayloadV3; 
- the same is it will be in the future(in case we try SSZ again)

Can be applied to proofs and commitments too

excerpts.author: __flcl
excerpts.content: Wdyt guys?

excerpts.author: __flcl
excerpts.content: OK if BLSFieldElement can have dynamic length it allows to save some length

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: each blob is flat vector i think

excerpts.author: g11tech
excerpts.content: so blobs => array of bytes array

excerpts.author: g11tech

excerpts.content: At least like that 👍

excerpts.content: but would want network transaction to change to: `[tx_payload, blobs, commitments, proofs]` (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7038) rather than current `[tx_payload, kzgs, blobs, kzg_proofs]`

excerpts.author: g11tech
